description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - SLSRS 4400 (Revised) Agreed upon Procedures
categorisation: This gazette content publishes the adoption of Sri Lanka Accounting Standard SLSRS 4400 (Revised) under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It contains regulatory framework and compliance requirements for accounting professionals, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
